name: Dropdown (select)
purpose: Choose one or many options from a list, with creation of a missing option inside the list.
whenToUse: Choosing from a known set of 3 to about 100 options (status, label, assignee).
Multi-select of labels or people, showing a count when more than one is chosen.
Choosing or creating an option in the same control (labels, tags, projects).
Compact forms and toolbars where radios would take too much space.
whenNotToUse: Two options: use a switch, a checkbox or a segmented control.
Up to 4 options that matter at a glance: use radios or tabs so choices are visible.
Commands. A menu lists actions, a dropdown stores a value.
A separate Create button beside the dropdown (P10). Put Create inside the list.
A search field when there are 7 options or fewer.
Native select styling that breaks the shared menu look.
anatomy: Trigger (.select): 32px, --s2 fill, value or muted placeholder, chevron-down at the end. aria-haspopup=listbox and aria-expanded.
Panel: the shared menu glass surface, at least as wide as the trigger.
Search (only above 7 options): filled input at the top, placeholder Search or Search or create label.
Options: label, optional icon, colour dot or meta. Single select shows a neutral check on the selected option; multi-select shows a checkbox.
Create row: appears at the bottom, after a separator, only when the query has no exact match (Create label "x").

variants.description: Choosing one option closes the panel.

variants.useWhen: Long lists such as labels, projects, people.

variants.description: A Create row appears inside the list for unmatched queries.
variants.useWhen: Open-ended sets such as labels or tags.

variants.description: Checkbox per option; panel stays open; trigger shows the value or a count.
No fill at rest; surface only on hover.
variants.useWhen: Inline in a toolbar or a dense row.

behavior: Search threshold: show the search field when there are more than 7 options.
Create inside the dropdown: typing a name with no exact match reveals Create label "name" at the bottom; Enter creates when nothing else matches. There is no separate Create button (AP-009).
Keys on the trigger: Enter, Space, Down or Up open the panel.
Keys in the panel: Up and Down move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter or Space picks, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes.
Type-ahead on lists without search: typing letters jumps to the next option starting with them.
With search: Down moves from the field into the list, Enter picks the first match.
Single select closes on pick. Multi-select stays open until Esc or outside click.
Max height 260px with scroll; the panel flips upward when there is no space below.
Check marks are neutral (--text), never emerald.
accessibility: Trigger: button with aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded and a name that includes the field label.
Panel: role=listbox, options role=option with aria-selected; add aria-multiselectable for multi-select.
Search input has an aria-label; announce the result count when it changes when practical.
Focus ring on the trigger is the shared 1.5px neutral ring; the focused option uses the hover fill.
Selection is shown with a check mark (single) or checkbox (multiple), not colour alone.
